parole.significato: biryani (South Asian dish of spiced rice)
parole.testo: Borrowed from English biryani, from Hindustani (Hindi बिरयानी (biryānī) / Urdu بِرْیَانی (biryānī)), from Classical Persian بِرْیَانِی (biryānī), from بِرْیَان (biryān, “roast”) (from برشتن (birištan, “to roast”)) + the suffix ـی (-ī).

parole.significato: Hindi; one of the official languages of India
parole.testo: Borrowed from English Hindi, Hindustani (Hindi हिंदी (hindī) / Urdu ہِنْدی (hindī)), or Classical Persian هندی (hindī), from هند (hind), from Sanskrit सिन्धु (sindhu).

parole.significato: hookah (smoking implement: type of water pipe)
parole.testo: From English hookah, from Hindustani حقہ / हुक़्क़ा (huqqā).

parole.significato: hot toddy, toddy, grog (drink made of hot water, strong liquor - usually rum - and sugar, sometimes also spices)
parole.testo: Borrowed from English toddy, in turn derived from Hindustani (Hindi ताड़ी (tāṛī) / Urdu تاڑی (tāṛī)), ultimately from Dravidian.
